name: AddEvent Calendar
author: AddEvent

sections.description:
A plugin to display an AddEvent calendar block in WordPress.
Features:
– Add a Add Event block.
– Customize the calendar through block settings.
– Display events based on Calendar ID.
– Supports various calendar views (month, week, day).

Donate

Currently, there is no donation link available. We appreciate your support and will update this section when donations are accepted.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the AddEvent Calendar to display and manage event calendars.

  • Service Used: AddEvent Calendar
  • What it Does: This service allows embedding and managing event calendars on your WordPress site.
  • Data Sent: When users interact with the calendar, requests are sent to AddEvent’s servers to fetch calendar events.
  • When is Data Sent: Data is transmitted when the calendar is loaded on the webpage.
  • Where is Data Sent: The requests go to https://cdn.addevent.com/libs/cal/js/cal.embed.t1.init.js.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.addevent.com/c/legal/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.addevent.com/c/legal/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policy of AddEvent.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/addevent directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I configure the Calendar ID?

When you add the Add Event block, you can set the Calendar ID in the block’s settings panel in the editor.

Can I manage events directly in WordPress?

Currently, the plugin uses an external service (like AddEvent) for event management. Events are displayed based on the Calendar ID provided.

How do I uninstall the plugin?

Deactivate and delete the plugin from the Plugins menu. All related data will be removed upon deletion.
